text:
Eng Pager Bot: P0 pager — RDMA retransmit spike + node flaps in eu-central-2 serving-pool-3. Error rate rising, observed multiple container restarts and OOMs on model-srv pods. Auto-fallback hasn’t completed for ~5m. Paging on-call. https://internal/redwood/pager/1951234567
Maya Patel: I'm oncall, acked. Looking at alerts and traces now.
Samir Gupta: seeing large IB retransmit counters on leaf switches; mlx5 shows `rq_overflow` and repeated timeouts. Linking netstats: `iblinkstat -r` looks noisy.
Lena Ortiz: which jobs are spiking? Any recent deploys to serving pool?
Maya Patel: no full deploys in last 30m. Traffic spike started ~10:12 UTC.
Samir Gupta: paste: ```
# ibstat summary (excerpt)
Port 1: LinkUp
   Link layer: IB
   Phys state: LinkUp
   Rate: 100Gb
   Retransmits: 1200
   Rx errors: 342
   Tx errors: 58
```
Samir Gupta: dmesg on node-12: ```
mlx5_core: detected retransmit due to ACK timeout
kernel: GPU OOM: process model-srv (pid 4321)
containerd: killing container model-srv due to oom
```
Kai Chen: I'm watching NIC counters on the rack. Looks like one top-of-rack switch has a flooding event — possibly a broadcast/fanout misconfiguration from a batch job.
Maya Patel: initial customer impact — some requests to AcmeCorp experiencing 5xx and timeouts. Jonah, could you flag CS?
Jonah Reyes (CS): flagged AcmeCorp, they report degraded inference 13% of calls failed between 10:12–10:20 UTC. They want ETA.
Maya Patel: mitigation plan: 1) isolate affected nodes (cordon + drain safe pods), 2) temporarily enable ethernet fallback for serving pool to stop RDMA storms, 3) scale down batch/fanout job in that rack.
Samir Gupta: executing isolation now: `kubectl cordon node-12 && kubectl drain node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=30`
Samir Gupta: scaling down noisy job: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment video-fanout --replicas=0` — doing now.
Lena Ortiz: runtime fallback: `redwood infra set-network-mode --pool serving-pool-3 --mode ethernet-fallback` — I'll trigger that. This will route traffic via TCP for affected pods, bypassing RDMA.
NOC Bot: switch alarms show transient port flaps on tor-4, ticket open #NOC-1123.
Maya Patel: update — scaled fanout job to 0, cordoned 2 nodes showing worst counters. Retransmit rate dropping but still elevated.
Kai Chen: applied ethernet-fallback; new pods are coming up with tcp path. Observed immediate drop in retransmits on affected nodes.
Samir Gupta: OOMs reduced after fallback; GPU containers staying up. Memory pressure earlier was correlated with packet reordering that caused request retries and KV cache growth.
Jonah Reyes (CS): telling AcmeCorp this is being mitigated, ETA ~10–15m for stabilization. They asked whether data was impacted — no evidence of data loss, only transient errors.
Maya Patel: confirm: rolling restart not required now; keeping nodes cordoned for 20m to ensure stability.
Lena Ortiz: opened an incident runbook task list and capturing logs for postmortem. Key items: capture ib counters, gpu logs, model-level retry metrics, and traffic profiles for 10:00–10:30 UTC.
Samir Gupta: note: kernel-level backoff didn't trigger fast enough; recommend we add automatic fallback trigger when IB retransmits per-second > 100 for 120s. Filing infra task.
Kai Chen: NOC suggests replacing TOR fiber/port on rack after hours if counters don't stabilize; creating follow-up ticket.
Maya Patel: service health: 10:21 UTC errors dropped to <1% for AcmeCorp; global error rate back to baseline. Keeping incident open for monitoring.
Eng Pager Bot: Incident status changed to 'mitigated' by Maya Patel. Next: postmortem scheduled 2025-04-22 09:00 UTC.
Maya Patel: handoff to Samir for deeper root cause and postmortem. Samir, you're the investigator. I'll mark oncall handoff done and go to lunch (will stay reachable).
Samir Gupta: taking postmortem ownership. I'll collect packet captures, switch logs, and model cache metrics. Possible action items: auto-fallback rule, add IB retransmit alert, and guard against fanout-induced broadcast storms.
Jonah Reyes (CS): I'll reach back to AcmeCorp with a summary once postmortem has the root cause.
Maya Patel: thanks team. If anything pops, ping me. :thumbsup:
